LOO 0.1512 vs v1 0.1512; LOBO 0.1458 vs v1 0.1458. v2 code on the uncorrected v1 file. v1 contains two HSE06 labels stored as PBE (Mg3BiI3, Mg3BiBr3); the v2 datasets fix them. These numbers check the code, not the data.
